messages:
margo: Heads up — CI microbench for PR 20678 failed on the prefetch/batch path. kvcache hitrate looks stable but tail latency for small batches spiked ~28% in the benchmark run.
liam: Ugh. Is this the kernel autoselect path or the new queue-throttle heuristic from the PR?
margo: Looks like both. The failure trace shows kernel switch happening at batch boundary + queue-throttle delaying coalescence. Repro snippet from runner:
```
benchctl run pr-20678 --bench microbatch --iters 200
# result: median latency 12.8ms -> 16.4ms (28% increase)
```
ci-bot: CI: performance check failed (pr=20678). Threshold exceeded for `microbatch_latency_median` on node group `linux-gpu-small`.
sophia: Can you paste the benchctl diff output?
margo: Sure — here's the minimal diff (new - baseline):
```
microbatch_latency_median: +3.6ms (+28%)
kv_cache_hitrate: -0.2% (noise)
batch_coalescing_ratio: -0.12
kernel_choice: auto -> fallback_kernel_v2
```
devon: batch_coalescing_ratio drop is suspicious — queue-throttle change in PR might be increasing wait time until the batch fills, then kernel chooses fallback due to shorter observed seqlen distribution.
anya: I can run an isolation run on my machine (A100) with verbose kernel logs. Give me 20m.
liam: Meanwhile, can we bisect whether the kernel autoselect tweak or the queue-throttle commit caused the break? Maybe revert queue-throttle locally.
margo: I did a quick local bisect: reverting just the queue-throttle heuristic brings latency back to baseline. Reverting kernel-autoselect alone did NOT fix it.
sophia: Good catch. Could be interaction: queue-throttle changes arrival pattern -> autoselect sees different seqlen histogram and picks fallback_kernel_v2 (slower for small batches).
ci-bot: Note: PR had been gated by smoke tests only; perf gate is failing now — marking PR as rollout-blocker.
devon: Proposal: add a short-circuit to autoselect that prevents switching to fallback_kernel_v2 for seqlen < 8 unless batch_coalescing_ratio > 0.5.
margo: That sounds reasonable. For now let's revert the queue-throttle change in the PR to unblock CI and open a follow-up to tune the autoselect tuning.
anya: I uploaded verbose trace: https://internal.artifacts/trace-20678/trace.log — contains kernel selection markers and kv cache stats.
liam: Thanks. Assigning follow-up: @margo to revert queue-throttle in the PR; @anya to run a battery of microbench across seqlen buckets; @sophia to draft autoselect guard.
margo: Reverted in PR, pushed fix, running CI again.
ci-bot: CI started for pr-20678 (post-revert).
ci-bot: CI: performance check passed (post-revert) — microbatch latency back within threshold :white_check_mark:
liam: Nice. Let's keep the rollback short and open a new RFC for coordinated changes to throttle+autoselect.
anya: I'll include flamegraphs and per-kernel breakdowns in the follow-up issue.
margo: Closing this thread; thanks team. :tada:
